why_it_matters: Requests, responses and the session cookie travel unencrypted and can be read or modified on the network. HSTS cannot be evaluated on an HTTP-only endpoint.
recommendation: Serve over HTTPS (TLS 1.2+) and then add Strict-Transport-Security.

recommendation: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response.

recommendation: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY or CSP frame-ancestors 'none'.
